title: Clinically integrated, ML-supported software to support systems medicine therapy decisions for artificial ventilation in intensive care medicine
summary: The main aim of the research project is to optimise and personalise the treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). ARDS is a disease of the lungs that leads to damage to the lung tissue as well as to impairment of other organs. The aim of the project is to research and further develop a ‘digital lung twin’ in cooperation with the company Ebenbuild GmbH. This simulated lung is part of a new type of digital support system to improve the treatment and ventilation of ARDS patients. Using retrospective clinical measurement and image data, methods and digital systems have been developed that permanently monitor the patient's condition and provide predictive results for the first time. The study aims to describe the processes and influences on various organs, such as the heart or lungs, during ARDS. The aim is to predict the influence of ventilation therapy on the body.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Indication for admission to an intensive care unit
- Mechanically ventilated patients 
- Hypoxaemic respiratory failure, defined as PaO2/FiO2 ratio ≤ 300 mmHg with invasive or non-invasive ventilation with PEEP ≥ 5 mbar
Exclusion criteria:
- Age under 18 years
- Pregnant patients
